title: Runtime consulting lifecycle — prevent infinite 'consultando...'
description: Every chat/external dispatch must reach a terminal state. Timeout watchdog + dispatch_id guards prevent the UI from staying in busy/consultando indefinitely.
resume_hint: Live UI proof with real user interaction pending. dispatch_started→terminal correlation now reconstructible via recent_dispatch_lifecycles().
next_action: Test on user's Windows machine with real chat interactions to confirm busy state always resolves and lifecycle is reconstructible.

metadata.coverage_detail: Timeout watchdog (120s chat, 180s external), dispatch_id stale-result guards, 8 terminal states defined, _humanize_task_failure classifier, _human_external_consultation_failure structured handoff.
metadata.p01_additions: Runtime audit trace on all terminal events (trace_dispatch_terminal). adaptive_action now guarded with dispatch_id + timeout watchdog. external_consultation blocked derives terminal_state from payload.meta.
metadata.p02_additions: trace_dispatch_started() on chat, external_consultation, adaptive_action. recent_dispatch_lifecycles() correlates started→terminal with duration_ms and unresolved flag. latestDispatchLifecycle read-only Property exposed.
